items.title: Inflation in Canada cools slightly to 2.2% in October, StatCan says
items.description: Year-over-year inflation for consumer goods rose by 2.2 per cent in October, a slight dip compared with the growth seen last month, according to Statistics Canada.

items.title: Toronto City Hall to raise Palestinian flag, joins other cities across Canada
items.description: The City of Toronto is expected to join several other cities across Canada in raising the Palestinian flag this morning at city hall.

items.description: The Richmond restaurant took home the honours once again.

items.title: Budget 2025 slashes Canada Student Grants, experts warn
items.description: Some experts are concerned that post-secondary students will have access to less money through the Canada Student Grant (CSG), based on a line item buried in Budget 2025.

items.title: TD Bank settles human rights complaint by B.C. Muslim-Indigenous man
items.description: A human rights complaint has been settled between TD Bank and a Muslim-Indigenous man who claimed he was racially profiled while trying to open a bank account.
